name: devlab
description: Task-centric project management with debate-driven planning, terminal dashboards, and confirmed Notion synchronization.

skills.name: setup
skills.shortDescription: Connect this repository to a Notion project
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $setup to connect this repository to its Notion project.

skills.name: sync
skills.shortDescription: Review and sync repository state to Notion
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $sync to review and sync repository state to Notion.

skills.name: dashboard
skills.shortDescription: Render project health and task progress
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $dashboard to show this project's task dashboard.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.shortDescription: Shape a product idea into a reviewed task
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $brainstorm to shape this idea into a reviewed task.

skills.name: task
skills.shortDescription: Plan a task through proposer and critic debate
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $task to plan this work through a proposer and critic debate.

skills.name: task-pick
skills.shortDescription: Choose the best unblocked task to start
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $task-pick to choose the best unblocked task to start.

skills.name: task-close
skills.shortDescription: Close work without violating task hierarchy
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $task-close to safely close a task and its descendants.

skills.name: task-transition
skills.shortDescription: Move a task through validated workflow states
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $task-transition to move a task to a valid workflow state.

interface.longDescription: DevLab connects a repository to a Notion project for confirmed synchronization, task planning, safe transitions, and terminal dashboards.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me manage this project's work with DevLab.
